en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Mhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> forefathers<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘
There is no goodness in the life except for two (types of) men – a scholar obeyed, or a retaining listener’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has narrated from his ancestors from the Holy Prophet (s.a.), who has said the following.
“There is nothing good in life except for two kinds of people: a scholar who is obeyed and an audience who listens carefully.”
